verdict.rationale: Cline's overview documents a first-party offering to "Build AI agents and integrations powered by the same core engine" behind its CLI, Kanban, VS Code and JetBrains products, so a developer building block exists. It is not explicitly named as an SDK, and its scope is thin. The OpenAPI probe found no published API spec. missing for 10: explicit SDK naming and package/install details, supported languages, API reference documentation, usage examples, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
